title: Gauging lipid vulnerabilities in mRNA-LNPs under various environmental stressors through TIMS-TOF analysis

The long-term stability of mRNA lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) is governed by the chemical resilience of their constituent lipids, yet the specific degradation pathways triggered by real-world stressors remain poorly defined.
